title: CardCorpus paintings
description: Every painting printed on more than one card. A painting is one piece of artwork: Base Set Charizard and its reprints in every language print the same one. Each entry is a pointer to the painting with its `printCount`, how many cards print it; follow it to paintings/{id}.json for the cards. They come by the set of their first print in the sets' order (sets/{catalog}.json, catalog by catalog), then in the order of those cards in their set's file (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#card-lists).

paintingCount.description: How many paintings printed on more than one card; always present, 0 included.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `painting`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The painting's own id, which never changes: its first print's English name and a short code, such as `charizard-k3f9`. Where it was first printed is `firstPrint`'s to say, corrected there when research finds an earlier print.
